scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck

FETCHR_PROXY_SECRET.description: HMAC key for signed download URLs. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Use at least 16 characters, and a different value for every deploy. Leave the example file empty.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile secret. Leave it empty to refuse requests that go over the rate limit.
